title: Large time stabilization of rough-data solutions in one-dimensional nonlinear thermoelasticity
summary: In an open bounded real interval $Ω$, the model for one-dimensional thermoelasticity given by \[ u_{tt} = u_{xx} - \big(f(Θ)\big)_x, \qquad Θ_t = Θ_{xx} - f(Θ) u_{xt}, \] is considered along with homogeneous boundary conditions of Dirichlet type for $u$ and of Neumann type for $Θ$, under the assumption that $f\in C^1([0,\infty))$ satisfies $f(0)=0$, $f'\in L^\infty((0,\infty))$ and $f'>0$ on $[0,\infty)$.
